context.text: Ticketing system note (ORD-113766), added by agent A-28: Order ORD-113766 (3 items, including the Lumen desk lamp) was placed on 2026-04-17 for delivery to Khobar. Order total: SAR 5,550.00. Status: Shipped. Shipped on 2026-04-20 with Naqel, tracking TRK-2634576. A duplicate check found no matching open cases. The customer was notified through the account portal. All timestamps are recorded in Riyadh local time.

Internal policy — Refund policy. Refunds for returned items are issued within 14 business days after the warehouse confirms receipt of the goods. Items returned without the original packaging incur a restocking fee of 85 percent. Refunds are paid to the original payment method unless the customer chooses store credit, which is issued instantly and carries a 10 percent bonus. Refund requests older than 59 days from delivery are reviewed manually by the Returns team. Attachments were checked and matched the submitted claim form. The case follows the standard handling procedure for this category.

Help centre page — How do I track my parcel? Open the order page and select Track. The tracking status updates every few hours once the carrier scans the parcel. If no scan appears after 5 business days, start a chat with support and have the order number ready. No further action is pending on this record at this time. Follow-up reminders are generated automatically by the system.

Internal policy — Price match. Nova Retail matches the advertised price of identical items sold by approved local retailers within 9 days of purchase. The customer must provide a link or a dated advertisement. Marketplace sellers, flash sales and bundle offers are excluded. Approved price matches are paid as store credit within 38 business days. Agent notes were translated to the customer's preferred language. The case follows the standard handling procedure for this category.

Internal policy — Shipping policy. Standard delivery within the Kingdom takes 2 to 20 business days depending on the destination city. Express delivery is available for orders above SAR 500 and is dispatched the same day when placed before 15:00. Carriers are selected automatically based on destination and parcel weight. Customers receive a tracking link once the parcel leaves the fulfilment centre. Follow-up reminders are generated automatically by the system. The warehouse confirmed the item scan on the inbound dock.

Help centre page — Can I change my delivery address? The address can be changed until the order reaches the packing stage. After that, contact the carrier directly using the tracking link; carriers usually allow one redirection per shipment at no cost. This record was last reviewed during the weekly quality audit. Service levels for this queue are reviewed every month.

Internal policy — Loyalty programme. Members earn 3 points for every SAR spent and 10 points for every verified product review. Points convert to store credit at a rate of 15 points per SAR. Points expire 89 months after they are earned unless the account has been active in the previous quarter. No further action is pending on this record at this time. The delivery window was communicated by text message.

Internal policy — Store credit rules. Store credit never expires and can be combined with promotional codes. Credit balances are shown on the account page and applied automatically at checkout. Credit cannot be converted back to cash except where required by law. A maximum of SAR 250 of credit can be used on a single order. Nothing unusual was flagged during the routine compliance check. The record is linked to the customer account in the CRM.
